mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_TRIAL_INQUIRY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TRIAL_INQUIRY ( INQUIRY_NO, MEMBER_NO, TRIAL_NO, BUSINESS_NO, SUBJECT, QUESTION, ANSWER, STATUS, CREATED_AT, ANSWERED_AT ) VALUES ( #{inquiryNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{memberNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trialNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{businessNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{subject,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{question,jdbcType=CLOB}, NULL, 'WAITING', SYSDATE, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO, I.MEMBER_NO, I.TRIAL_NO, I.BUSINESS_NO, I.SUBJECT, I.QUESTION, I.ANSWER, I.STATUS, I.CREATED_AT, I.ANSWERED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.SOURCE_TYPE, T.INSTITUTION_NAME FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY I JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = I.TRIAL_NO WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY I.CREATED_AT DESC, I.INQUIRY_NO DESC

SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO, I.MEMBER_NO, I.TRIAL_NO, I.BUSINESS_NO, I.SUBJECT, I.QUESTION, I.ANSWER, I.STATUS, I.CREATED_AT, I.ANSWERED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.SOURCE_TYPE, T.INSTITUTION_NAME FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY I JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = I.TRIAL_NO WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND I.INQUIRY_NO = #{inquiryNo}

SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO, I.MEMBER_NO, I.TRIAL_NO, I.BUSINESS_NO, I.SUBJECT, I.QUESTION, I.ANSWER, I.STATUS, I.CREATED_AT, I.ANSWERED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.SOURCE_TYPE, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.EMAIL AS MEMBER_EMAIL FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY I JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = I.TRIAL_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = I.MEMBER_NO WHERE I.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN I.STATUS = 'WAITING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, I.CREATED_AT DESC, I.INQUIRY_NO DESC

SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO, I.MEMBER_NO, I.TRIAL_NO, I.BUSINESS_NO, I.SUBJECT, I.QUESTION, I.ANSWER, I.STATUS, I.CREATED_AT, I.ANSWERED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.SOURCE_TYPE, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.EMAIL AS MEMBER_EMAIL FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY I JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = I.TRIAL_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = I.MEMBER_NO WHERE I.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND I.INQUIRY_NO = #{inquiryNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIAL_INQUIRY SET ANSWER = #{answer,jdbcType=CLOB}, STATUS = 'ANSWERED', ANSWERED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND INQUIRY_NO = #{inquiryNo} AND STATUS IN ('WAITING', 'ANSWERED')
